name: Author can search the library and open a published SOP

planSteps.description: Sign in as alex.rivera@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
Type 'Leave request' into the search input (input with aria-label 'Search keyword') and wait for the results to update
The results list contains a result titled 'Leave request' showing its department
The SOP detail page opens with the heading 'Leave request', a version badge (e.g. 'Published · v2.2'), and a 'Version history' link
